description: Implicit definition is equivalent to the union of the two renamed copies of the theory entailing agreement of the two fresh relations.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.implicit_iff_two_copies.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (T : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Theory) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.Implicit T ↔
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side false).onTheory T ∪
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side true).onTheory T ⊨ᵇ
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.agreement
